title: Circuit routing on context: the router sees the token and the sequence so far
follows: R1.04 (PARTIAL: token routing specialises without gain), R1.22 (PASS: real sparse dispatch saves time)
question: If the router sees a task representation (the causal mean of the sequence so far) next to the token, does it build task-specific circuits (higher token-conditioned task-expert NMI) and gain accuracy over token-only routing at equal active compute?

predictions.PASS: context routing gains >= 2 points over token routing AND its token-conditioned task-expert NMI is >= 0.05 higher
predictions.C3: reported: beats the dense Transformer of equal active size by >= 2 points

prior_art: Switch 2101.03961, task-level MoE routing (e.g. Task-MoE, Kudugunta et al. 2021), Mixture-of-Depths 2404.02258
not_claimed: Routing on richer inputs is prior art; the measurement on this benchmark is the question.
